activity_statements.statement: operates as the nation's largest exterior home remodeling company, selling and installing roofing, windows, siding, and doors directly to residential homeowners
uses a direct-to-consumer in-home sales model across 26 regional offices nationwide
installs exterior remodeling products for residential customers across the US with in-house installation crews

name_reality_gap: The name accurately describes the business: exterior home remodeling. The 'Construction' index label is close but slightly misleading — Power does not build new structures; it retrofits existing homes with exterior products sold and installed through a direct-sales force.
extraction_notes: About page was largely marketing language with FAQs that did not expand. Core activity facts (largest exterior remodeler, 26 regional offices, roofing/windows/siding/doors) were extractable. Detailed revenue or staffing data not publicly available as a private company.
